findings.problem: The hint rules out miel, but other common pet names still fit, especially mi amor, amor, corazón, cielo and mi vida, and mi amor is at least as common as cariño in Latin America.
findings.fix: hint: what you call a loved one, the same word that means affection (not amor, cielo or corazón)

back.es: affection, fondness; as a form of address: darling, honey, sweetheart

note: Linking this card's hint to the affection card helps the learner see that it is one word with two uses; when cariño is used to address someone, as in the example, it takes no article.
